    15	# `proposed` (an explicit --status open stays open: an open question, not a decision taken),
    16	# proposed_by is agent, and --answer-ref / --as are ignored with a WARN. Only the operator-only
    17	# /decisions command passes --recorded-by decisions-command, the one caller of `confirm`, of
    18	# `reject`/`supersede` on a decided row and of `context --clear`.
    19	#
    20	# A linked worktree (git-common-dir differs from git-dir) or --pending writes
    21	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-<N>/decisions-pending.yaml with PEND-<8 hex> ids; `import` in the
    22	# main checkout allocates the real DEC ids. Live-ledger writes exit 1 under CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS
    23	# or LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT=1 (--file fixtures are exempt so the suites run in CI).

    27	#              [--status open|proposed] [--decision D --rationale W --alternative-json J ...]
    28	#              [--consequence-pos X ...] [--consequence-neg X ...] [--answer-ref REF]
    29	#              [--as flatline|dissent] [--cycle C] [--evidence E] [--pending] [--sprint N]
    30	#   decide     --id ID --decision D --rationale W --alternative-json J ... --evidence E --recorded-by R
    31	#              [--answer-ref REF] [--consequence-pos X ...] [--consequence-neg X ...]
    32	#   confirm    --recorded-by decisions-command --evidence E (--id ID ... | --cycle C [--all])

   211	  mkdir -p "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run"
   212	  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ "${LOA_DEC_NO_FLOCK:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
   213	    exec 9>"$lp"
   214	    flock -w "$LOCK_WAIT" 9 || die "lock busy: another writer holds ${lp} (waited ${LOCK_WAIT}s); retry"
   215	    return 0
   216	  fi
   217	  local d="${lp}.d" tries=$(( LOCK_WAIT * 10 )) pid
   218	  while ! mkdir "$d" 2>/dev/null; do
   219	    pid="$(cat "$d/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)"
   220	    # Stale: older than 60 s and its owner is gone.
   221	    if [[ -n "$(find "$d" -maxdepth 0 -mmin +1 2>/dev/null)" ]] && { [[ -z "$pid" ]] || ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; }; then
   222	      rm -f "$d/pid" 2>/dev/null; rmdir "$d" 2>/dev/null || true; continue
   223	    fi
   224	    tries=$(( tries - 1 ))
   225	    (( tries > 0 )) || die "lock busy: another writer holds ${d} (waited ${LOCK_WAIT}s); retry"
   226	    sleep 0.1
   227	  done
   228	  MKLOCK="$d"
   229	  printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$d/pid"
   230	}

   392	# verify_and_swap OLD_JSON ADDED TOUCHED_IDS_JSON
   393	verify_and_swap(){
   394	  local old="$1" added="$2" touched="$3" errs
   395	  # Whole-ledger JSON goes through files (--slurpfile): a large ledger overflows one argv string.
   396	  SCRATCH="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dec-verify.XXXXXX")"
   397	  printf '%s' "$old" > "${SCRATCH}.old"
   398	  yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$TMPF" > "${SCRATCH}.new" 2>/dev/null || die "ABORT: the candidate ledger does not parse; ledger untouched"
   399	  errs="$(jq -rn --slurpfile O "${SCRATCH}.old" --slurpfile N "${SCRATCH}.new" --argjson added "$added" --argjson t "$touched" '
   400	    $O[0] as $o | $N[0] as $n
   401	    | ($o.decisions | map(.id)) as $oi | (($n.decisions // []) | map(.id)) as $ni
   402	    | (($n.decisions // []) | map(select(type == "object" and (.id | type) == "string") | {key: .id, value: .}) | from_entries) as $nb
   403	    | ($oi | map({key: ., value: true}) | from_entries) as $os | ($t | map({key: ., value: true}) | from_entries) as $ts
   404	    | [ (if $n.schema_version != 1 then "unknown schema_version" else empty end),
   405	        (if ($n.decisions | type) != "array" then "decisions is not a sequence" else empty end),
   406	        ($oi - $ni | .[] | "would drop id \(.)"),
   407	        ($ni | group_by(.) | map(select(length > 1) | .[0]) | .[] | "duplicate id \(.)"),
   408	        (if ($ni | length) != (($o.decisions | length) + $added) then "row count \($ni | length) != \($o.decisions | length) + \($added)" else empty end),
   409	        ($o.decisions[] as $r | select($ts[$r.id] | not) | select($nb[$r.id] != $r) | "row \($r.id) changed outside this operation"),
   410	        ($n.decisions[] | .id as $x | select($os[$x] | not) | select($ts[$x] | not) | "unexpected new row \($x)")
   411	      ] | .[]')" || die "ABORT: verification failed to run; ledger untouched"
   412	  [[ -z "$errs" ]] || die "ABORT: ${errs//$'\n'/; }; ledger untouched"
   413	  [[ -f "$VALIDATOR" ]] || die "ABORT: validator missing at ${VALIDATOR}; ledger untouched"
   414	  local vout

   424	# Build a new row JSON. Args: id status voice ref sha supersedes
   425	build_row(){
   426	  local id="$1" status="$2" voice="$3" ref="$4" sha="$5" sup="$6"
   427	  local summary phase category source decision rationale alts cons rb cyc now ev
   428	  summary="$(san1 "$(o summary)")"; phase="$(san1 "$(o phase)")"; category="$(san1 "$(o category)")"; source="$(san1 "$(o source)")"
   429	  [[ -n "$summary" ]] || usage "--summary is required"
   430	  # characters, not bytes (LC_ALL=C makes ${#x} a byte count): the validator's limit is 160 code points
   431	  [[ "$(jq -rn --arg s "$summary" '$s | length')" -le 160 ]] || die "--summary is over 160 characters; one plain line"
   432	  [[ "$phase" =~ ^(discovery|architecture|sprint-planning|implementation|review|charting|spike|operations)$ ]] || usage "--phase must be discovery|architecture|sprint-planning|implementation|review|charting|spike|operations"
   433	  [[ "$category" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ ]] || usage "--category must match [a-z][a-z0-9-]* (e.g. scope, technology, architecture)"
   434	  [[ -n "$source" ]] || usage "--source is required (bead id, PR, NOTES anchor, spike path, with a line or anchor)"
   435	  decision="$(san1 "$(o decision)")"; rationale="$(san1 "$(o rationale)")"; alts="$(alts_json)"; cons="$(cons_json)"
   436	  if [[ "$status" == "proposed" ]]; then
   437	    [[ -n "$decision" && -n "$rationale" && "$(printf '%s' "$alts" | jq 'length')" -ge 1 ]] \
   438	      || die "a proposed row needs --decision, --rationale and at least one --alternative-json"
   439	  fi
   440	  rb="$(recorded_by)"; cyc="$(san1 "$(o cycle)")"; [[ -n "$cyc" ]] || cyc="$(default_cycle)"
   441	  if [[ -z "$cyc" ]] && is_unattended; then warn "no cycle id (pass --cycle); the row's cycle is null"; fi
   442	  now="$(now_utc)"; ev="$(san1 "$(o evidence)")"; [[ -n "$ev" ]] || ev="$source"
   443	  jq -cn --arg id "$id" --arg now "$now" --arg phase "$phase" --arg category "$category" --arg summary "$summary" \
   444	    --arg decision "$decision" --arg rationale "$rationale" --argjson alts "$alts" --argjson cons "$cons" \
   445	    --arg voice "$voice" --arg ref "$ref" --arg sha "$sha" --arg rb "${rb}/$(session_id)" --arg by "${voice}:${rb}" \
   446	    --arg commit "$(head_commit)" --arg source "$source" --arg cycle "$cyc" --arg sup "$sup" --arg status "$status" --arg ev "$ev" '
   447	    def n: if . == "" then null else . end;
   448	    {id: $id, created_at: $now, updated_at: $now, phase: $phase, category: $category, summary: $summary,
   449	     decision: ($decision | n), rationale: ($rationale | n),
   450	     alternatives_considered: (if ($alts | length) == 0 then null else $alts end), consequences: $cons,
   451	     proposed_by: $voice, decided_by: null, decided_by_ref: ($ref | n), evidence_sha256: ($sha | n),
   452	     recorded_by: $rb, commit: $commit, source: $source, cycle: ($cycle | n), supersedes: ($sup | n),
   453	     supersede_proposed_by: null, status: $status,
   454	     transitions: [{at: $now, from: null, to: $status, by: $by, evidence: $ev}],
   455	     rejection_rationale: null, follow_up: null, prior_requests: []}'
   456	}

commands.name: deep-research
commands.description: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. (dynamic workflow)

commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Enable debug logging for this session and help diagnose issues

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's review recipe covers them) at the given effort level (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings up to many, some of them uncertain); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default.

commands.name: simplify
commands.description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Research and plan a large-scale change, then execute it in parallel across 5–30 isolated worktree agents that each open a PR.

commands.name: fewer-permission-prompts
commands.description: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Health-check the user's Claude Code setup and fix issues: diagnose installation health — what the `claude doctor` terminal diagnostics cover — from local data (duplicate or leftover installs, PATH, unparseable settings files, broken or colliding agent definitions, skills whose frontmatter fails to parse); find unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins versus their context cost and disable dead weight; deduplicate local CLAUDE.md files against checked-in ones; trim checked-in CLAUDE.md files by cutting content a session could derive from the codebase (directory layouts, tech-stack lists, architecture overviews) while keeping gotchas, rationale, and non-standard conventions; migrate always-loaded CLAUDE.md guidance into lazy skills and nested CLAUDE.md files; flag slow hooks and context-heavy extensions; check the installed version is current; make auto mode the default permission mode; and pre-approve frequently denied read-only commands. Use when the user asks for a doctor run, checkup, audit, tune-up, or cleanup of their Claude Code setup or configuration.

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace.

commands.name: claude-api
commands.description:
Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).

commands.name: workflow-authoring
commands.description: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script (script API and gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples). Load before authoring a script for a workflow the user already opted into; it does not itself authorize running one.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

commands.name: run-skill-generator
commands.description: Author or improve the run-<unit> skill - a per-project skill that tells agents how to build, launch, and drive this project's app. Use when the user asks to set up the project, get it running, write run instructions, or verify build/run steps work from a clean environment.

commands.name: plugin-authoring
commands.description: Make a mod: a change to Claude's own interface or behaviour, such as a live pane or panel, a band above the prompt, a status line, a toast, a slash command, or a hook on tool calls or prompts. Use to make, change or debug a mod or its hooks module.

commands.description: Meta-orchestrator for the FULL Loa lifecycle (discover -> design -> implement -> audit -> submit -> learn) with mandatory quality gates — use when starting from raw requirements with no PRD/SDD/sprint plan yet. (Contrast: run-mode executes an EXISTING sprint plan; simstim keeps a human in the planning loop.) (from pr/head/.claude/skills — applies when working on files under pr/head/) (project)

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash

3	# tools/check-round-independence.sh: is an interview transcript asked in
4	# prerequisite-ordered rounds?
5	#
6	# In `interview.pacing: rounds` every round of questions ends with one comment
7	# block (discovering-requirements/resources/REFERENCE.md §Question Pacing):
8	#
9	#   <!-- round: 2; questions: [{"id":"Q4","depends_on":[]},{"id":"Q2","depends_on":[],"reasked":true}] -->
10	#
11	# This checker reads those blocks from a transcript (markdown or plain text,
12	# one block per line) and fails when:
13	#   * a `depends_on` names a question asked in the same round,
14	#   * a `depends_on` names a question not asked in an earlier round,
15	#   * a non-reasked id repeats, or a `reasked` id was never asked before,
16	#   * round numbers do not increase, or a block is malformed,
17	#   * the rounds average fewer than --min-average new questions (default 2).
18	# `reasked` entries are skipped for id uniqueness and for the average. The
19	# final round is exempt from the average when there are two or more rounds.
20	#
21	# Usage:
22	#   tools/check-round-independence.sh <transcript> [--min-average N] [--json]
23	#
24	# Exit codes: 0 independent · 1 violation · 2 usage, unreadable file, or no
25	#             round block in the transcript
26	# =============================================================================
27	set -euo pipefail
28	export LC_ALL=C
29	
30	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
31	
32	TRANSCRIPT=""
33	MIN_AVG="2"
34	JSON=0
35	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
36	  case "$1" in
37	    --min-average)
38	      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: --min-average needs a number" >&2; exit 2; }
39	      MIN_AVG="$2"; shift 2 ;;
40	    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
41	    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
42	    --) shift; [[ $# -ge 1 ]] && { TRANSCRIPT="$1"; shift; } ;;
43	    -*) echo "check-round-independence.sh: unknown flag $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
44	    *)
45	      [[ -z "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: one transcript only" >&2; exit 2; }
46	      TRANSCRIPT="$1"; shift ;;
47	  esac
48	done
49	
50	[[ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: transcript path required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
51	[[ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" && -r "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: cannot read $TRANSCRIPT" >&2; exit 2; }
52	[[ "$MIN_AVG" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: --min-average must be a non-negative number, got '$MIN_AVG'" >&2; exit 2; }
53	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: jq is required" >&2; exit 2; }
54	
55	BLOCK_RE='<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[[:space:]]*;[[:space:]]*questions:[[:space:]]*\[.*\][[:space:]]*-->'
56	
57	# One JSON object per block: {round, questions} or {round, malformed}. grep exits
58	# 1 on no match, which is the "no block" case below, not an error.
59	blocks="$(grep -oE "$BLOCK_RE" "$TRANSCRIPT" || true)"
60	if [[ -z "$blocks" ]]; then
61	  echo "check-round-independence.sh: no <!-- round: N; questions: [...] --> block in $TRANSCRIPT" >&2
62	  exit 2
63	fi
64	
65	rounds_json="[]"
66	while IFS= read -r block; do
67	  [[ -n "$block" ]] || continue
68	  n="$(printf '%s\n' "$block" | sed -E 's/^<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*([0-9]+).*/\1/')"
69	  [[ ${#n} -le 9 ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: round number $n is too long" >&2; exit 1; }
70	  n=$((10#$n))   # "02" is not valid JSON; the round number is decimal
71	  arr="$(printf '%s\n' "$block" | sed -E 's/^<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[[:space:]]*;[[:space:]]*questions:[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*-->$//')"
72	  if printf '%s' "$arr" | jq -e 'type == "array" and all(.[];
73	        type == "object" and (.id | type == "string" and length > 0)
74	        and (.depends_on | type == "array" and all(.[]; type == "string")))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
75	    entry="$(jq -cn --argjson r "$n" --argjson q "$arr" '{round: $r, questions: $q}')"
76	  else
77	    entry="$(jq -cn --argjson r "$n" --arg raw "$arr" '{round: $r, malformed: $raw}')"
78	  fi
79	  rounds_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$rounds_json" --argjson e "$entry" '$a + [$e]')"
80	done <<< "$blocks"
81	
82	report="$(jq -n --argjson rounds "$rounds_json" --argjson min "$MIN_AVG" '
83	  reduce range(0; $rounds | length) as $i (
84	    {asked: [], violations: [], per_round: [], prev: null};
85	    $rounds[$i] as $r
86	    | (if .prev != null and $r.round <= .prev
87	         then .violations += ["round \($r.round) does not follow round \(.prev)"] else . end)
88	    | .prev = $r.round
89	    | if $r.malformed != null then
90	        .violations += ["round \($r.round): malformed questions array (each entry needs a string id and a depends_on array of strings)"]
91	        | .per_round += [{round: $r.round, new: 0, reasked: 0, ids: []}]
92	      else
93	        ($r.questions | map(.id)) as $here
94	        | .asked as $before
95	        | reduce $r.questions[] as $q (.;
96	            ($q.reasked == true) as $re
97	            | (if $re then
98	                 (if ($before | index([$q.id])) == null
99	                    then .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) is marked reasked but was not asked in an earlier round"] else . end)
100	               else
101	                 (if (.asked | index([$q.id])) != null
102	                    then .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) is asked again without \"reasked\": true"] else . end)
103	                 | .asked += [$q.id]
104	               end)
105	            | reduce $q.depends_on[] as $d (.;
106	                if ($here | index([$d])) != null and $d != $q.id then
107	                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on \($d), asked in the same round"]
108	                elif $d == $q.id then
109	                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on itself"]
110	                elif ($before | index([$d])) == null then
111	                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on \($d), not asked in an earlier round"]
112	                else . end))
113	        | .per_round += [{
114	            round: $r.round,
115	            new: ($r.questions | map(select(.reasked != true)) | length),
116	            reasked: ($r.questions | map(select(.reasked == true)) | length),
117	            ids: $here }]
118	      end)
119	  | .counted = (if (.per_round | length) >= 2 then .per_round[0:-1] else .per_round end)
120	  | .average = (if (.counted | length) == 0 then 0
121	                else ((.counted | map(.new) | add) / (.counted | length)) end)
122	  | (if .average < $min
123	       then .violations += ["average \(.average * 100 | round / 100) new questions per round is below --min-average \($min)"] else . end)
124	  | {
125	      rounds: (.per_round | length),
126	      questions: (.per_round | map(.new) | add),
127	      reasked: (.per_round | map(.reasked) | add),
128	      average: (.average * 100 | round / 100),
129	      min_average: $min,
130	      final_round_exempt: ((.per_round | length) >= 2),
131	      per_round: .per_round,
132	      violations: .violations,
133	      verdict: (if (.violations | length) == 0 then "PASS" else "FAIL" end)
134	    }')"
135	
136	if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
137	  printf '%s\n' "$report"
138	else
139	  printf '%s\n' "$report" | jq -r '
140	    (.per_round[] | "round \(.round): \(.new) new question(s)\(if .reasked > 0 then ", \(.reasked) re-asked" else "" end) [\(.ids | join(" "))]"),
141	    "rounds: \(.rounds); questions: \(.questions); average: \(.average) per round\(if .final_round_exempt then " (final round exempt)" else "" end); min-average: \(.min_average)",
142	    (.violations[] | "VIOLATION: \(.)"),
143	    .verdict'
144	fi
145	
146	verdict="$(printf '%s\n' "$report" | jq -r '.verdict')"
147	[[ "$verdict" == "PASS" ]]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# tools/check-round-independence.sh: is an interview transcript asked in
# prerequisite-ordered rounds?
#
# In `interview.pacing: rounds` every round of questions ends with one comment
# block (discovering-requirements/resources/REFERENCE.md §Question Pacing):
#
#   <!-- round: 2; questions: [{"id":"Q4","depends_on":[]},{"id":"Q2","depends_on":[],"reasked":true}] -->
#
# This checker reads those blocks from a transcript (markdown or plain text,
# one block per line) and fails when:
#   * a `depends_on` names a question asked in the same round,
#   * a `depends_on` names a question not asked in an earlier round,
#   * a non-reasked id repeats, or a `reasked` id was never asked before,
#   * round numbers do not increase, or a block is malformed,
#   * the rounds average fewer than --min-average new questions (default 2).
# `reasked` entries are skipped for id uniqueness and for the average. The
# final round is exempt from the average when there are two or more rounds.
#
# Usage:
#   tools/check-round-independence.sh <transcript> [--min-average N] [--json]
#
# Exit codes: 0 independent · 1 violation · 2 usage, unreadable file, or no
#             round block in the transcript
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }

TRANSCRIPT=""
MIN_AVG="2"
JSON=0
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --min-average)
      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: --min-average needs a number" >&2; exit 2; }
      MIN_AVG="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    --) shift; [[ $# -ge 1 ]] && { TRANSCRIPT="$1"; shift; } ;;
    -*) echo "check-round-independence.sh: unknown flag $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)
      [[ -z "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: one transcript only" >&2; exit 2; }
      TRANSCRIPT="$1"; shift ;;
  esac
done

[[ -n "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: transcript path required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -f "$TRANSCRIPT" && -r "$TRANSCRIPT" ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: cannot read $TRANSCRIPT" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ "$MIN_AVG" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: --min-average must be a non-negative number, got '$MIN_AVG'" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: jq is required" >&2; exit 2; }

BLOCK_RE='<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[[:space:]]*;[[:space:]]*questions:[[:space:]]*\[.*\][[:space:]]*-->'

# One JSON object per block: {round, questions} or {round, malformed}. grep exits
# 1 on no match, which is the "no block" case below, not an error.
blocks="$(grep -oE "$BLOCK_RE" "$TRANSCRIPT" || true)"
if [[ -z "$blocks" ]]; then
  echo "check-round-independence.sh: no <!-- round: N; questions: [...] --> block in $TRANSCRIPT" >&2
  exit 2
fi

rounds_json="[]"
while IFS= read -r block; do
  [[ -n "$block" ]] || continue
  n="$(printf '%s\n' "$block" | sed -E 's/^<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*([0-9]+).*/\1/')"
  [[ ${#n} -le 9 ]] || { echo "check-round-independence.sh: round number $n is too long" >&2; exit 1; }
  n=$((10#$n))   # "02" is not valid JSON; the round number is decimal
  arr="$(printf '%s\n' "$block" | sed -E 's/^<!--[[:space:]]*round:[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[[:space:]]*;[[:space:]]*questions:[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*-->$//')"
  if printf '%s' "$arr" | jq -e 'type == "array" and all(.[];
        type == "object" and (.id | type == "string" and length > 0)
        and (.depends_on | type == "array" and all(.[]; type == "string")))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    entry="$(jq -cn --argjson r "$n" --argjson q "$arr" '{round: $r, questions: $q}')"
  else
    entry="$(jq -cn --argjson r "$n" --arg raw "$arr" '{round: $r, malformed: $raw}')"
  fi
  rounds_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$rounds_json" --argjson e "$entry" '$a + [$e]')"
done <<< "$blocks"

report="$(jq -n --argjson rounds "$rounds_json" --argjson min "$MIN_AVG" '
  reduce range(0; $rounds | length) as $i (
    {asked: [], violations: [], per_round: [], prev: null};
    $rounds[$i] as $r
    | (if .prev != null and $r.round <= .prev
         then .violations += ["round \($r.round) does not follow round \(.prev)"] else . end)
    | .prev = $r.round
    | if $r.malformed != null then
        .violations += ["round \($r.round): malformed questions array (each entry needs a string id and a depends_on array of strings)"]
        | .per_round += [{round: $r.round, new: 0, reasked: 0, ids: []}]
      else
        ($r.questions | map(.id)) as $here
        | .asked as $before
        | reduce $r.questions[] as $q (.;
            ($q.reasked == true) as $re
            | (if $re then
                 (if ($before | index([$q.id])) == null
                    then .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) is marked reasked but was not asked in an earlier round"] else . end)
               else
                 (if (.asked | index([$q.id])) != null
                    then .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) is asked again without \"reasked\": true"] else . end)
                 | .asked += [$q.id]
               end)
            | reduce $q.depends_on[] as $d (.;
                if ($here | index([$d])) != null and $d != $q.id then
                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on \($d), asked in the same round"]
                elif $d == $q.id then
                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on itself"]
                elif ($before | index([$d])) == null then
                  .violations += ["round \($r.round): \($q.id) depends on \($d), not asked in an earlier round"]
                else . end))
        | .per_round += [{
            round: $r.round,
            new: ($r.questions | map(select(.reasked != true)) | length),
            reasked: ($r.questions | map(select(.reasked == true)) | length),
            ids: $here }]
      end)
  | .counted = (if (.per_round | length) >= 2 then .per_round[0:-1] else .per_round end)
  | .average = (if (.counted | length) == 0 then 0
                else ((.counted | map(.new) | add) / (.counted | length)) end)
  | (if .average < $min
       then .violations += ["average \(.average * 100 | round / 100) new questions per round is below --min-average \($min)"] else . end)
  | {
      rounds: (.per_round | length),
      questions: (.per_round | map(.new) | add),
      reasked: (.per_round | map(.reasked) | add),
      average: (.average * 100 | round / 100),
      min_average: $min,
      final_round_exempt: ((.per_round | length) >= 2),
      per_round: .per_round,
      violations: .violations,
      verdict: (if (.violations | length) == 0 then "PASS" else "FAIL" end)
    }')"

if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$report"
else
  printf '%s\n' "$report" | jq -r '
    (.per_round[] | "round \(.round): \(.new) new question(s)\(if .reasked > 0 then ", \(.reasked) re-asked" else "" end) [\(.ids | join(" "))]"),
    "rounds: \(.rounds); questions: \(.questions); average: \(.average) per round\(if .final_round_exempt then " (final round exempt)" else "" end); min-average: \(.min_average)",
    (.violations[] | "VIOLATION: \(.)"),
    .verdict'
fi

verdict="$(printf '%s\n' "$report" | jq -r '.verdict')"
[[ "$verdict" == "PASS" ]]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# loa-decisions-surface.sh: SessionStart hook that surfaces pending decision rows.
4	#
5	# Prints up to 10 `proposed` then `open` rows of grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml (id, status,
6	# summary only) so the operator sees what awaits /decisions confirm. DEFAULT-OFF: gated on
7	# `decisions.surface_at_session_start` (default false) in .loa.config.yaml.
8	#
9	# CONTRACT (observability, never a gate; same as loa-kf-surface.sh):
10	#   - Exits 0 on every path and never blocks a session.
11	#   - Disabled, no config, or no Mike Farah yq v4: prints nothing.
12	#   - Enabled but the ledger is unreadable or has an unknown schema_version: one
13	#     "[DECISIONS] WARNING ..." line on stdout.
14	#   - Enabled and healthy: the block on stdout (SessionStart injects stdout as context);
15	#     nothing when no row is open or proposed and no marker is stale.
16	#   - A stale .run/unattended.json (another session, or older than
17	#     decisions.unattended_marker_ttl_hours, default 24) adds one notice line.
18	#
19	# TRUST BOUNDARY: row text is agent-authored and UNTRUSTED. Only id, status and summary are
20	#   read; each summary is control-stripped (C0, C1, U+2028/9), angle brackets are replaced so
21	#   no tag can close the fence, and it is capped at 100 characters. The whole block is then
22	#   wrapped by the L6 data fence, sanitize_for_session_start L6 <block> --max-chars 2000
23	#   (context-isolation-lib.sh). Without that sanitizer the block is not printed.
24	# =============================================================================
25	set -uo pipefail
26	
27	HOOK_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
28	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${HOOK_DIR}/../../.." && pwd)"
29	
30	# Test seam (mirrors loa-kf-surface.sh): overrides are honoured only under
31	# LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_MODE=1 with a bats marker present.
32	_dec_test_mode_active() {
33	  [[ "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_MODE:-0}" == "1" ]] || return 1
34	  [[ -n "${BATS_TEST_FILENAME:-}" || -n "${BATS_VERSION:-}" ]]
35	}
36	
37	command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
38	[[ "$(yq --version 2>&1 || true)" == *mikefarah*"version v4."* ]] || exit 0
39	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
40	
41	config_path="${REPO_ROOT}/.loa.config.yaml"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# loa-decisions-surface.sh: SessionStart hook that surfaces pending decision rows.
#
# Prints up to 10 `proposed` then `open` rows of grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml (id, status,
# summary only) so the operator sees what awaits /decisions confirm. DEFAULT-OFF: gated on
# `decisions.surface_at_session_start` (default false) in .loa.config.yaml.
#
# CONTRACT (observability, never a gate; same as loa-kf-surface.sh):
#   - Exits 0 on every path and never blocks a session.
#   - Disabled, no config, or no Mike Farah yq v4: prints nothing.
#   - Enabled but the ledger is unreadable or has an unknown schema_version: one
#     "[DECISIONS] WARNING ..." line on stdout.
#   - Enabled and healthy: the block on stdout (SessionStart injects stdout as context);
#     nothing when no row is open or proposed and no marker is stale.
#   - A stale .run/unattended.json (another session, or older than
#     decisions.unattended_marker_ttl_hours, default 24) adds one notice line.
#
# TRUST BOUNDARY: row text is agent-authored and UNTRUSTED. Only id, status and summary are
#   read; each summary is control-stripped (C0, C1, U+2028/9), angle brackets are replaced so
#   no tag can close the fence, and it is capped at 100 characters. The whole block is then
#   wrapped by the L6 data fence, sanitize_for_session_start L6 <block> --max-chars 2000
#   (context-isolation-lib.sh). Without that sanitizer the block is not printed.
# =============================================================================
set -uo pipefail

HOOK_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${HOOK_DIR}/../../.." && pwd)"

# Test seam (mirrors loa-kf-surface.sh): overrides are honoured only under
# LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_MODE=1 with a bats marker present.
_dec_test_mode_active() {
  [[ "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_MODE:-0}" == "1" ]] || return 1
  [[ -n "${BATS_TEST_FILENAME:-}" || -n "${BATS_VERSION:-}" ]]
}

command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
[[ "$(yq --version 2>&1 || true)" == *mikefarah*"version v4."* ]] || exit 0
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0

config_path="${REPO_ROOT}/.loa.config.yaml"
enabled="false"
if _dec_test_mode_active && [[ -n "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_CONFIG-}" ]]; then
  enabled="${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_CONFIG}"
elif [[ -f "$config_path" ]]; then
  enabled="$(yq '.decisions.surface_at_session_start // false' "$config_path" 2>/dev/null || echo false)"
fi
[[ "$enabled" == "true" ]] || exit 0

LEDGER="${REPO_ROOT}/grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml"
RUN_DIR="${REPO_ROOT}/.run"
if _dec_test_mode_active; then
  [[ -n "${LOA_DECISIONS_FILE:-}" ]] && LEDGER="${LOA_DECISIONS_FILE}"
  [[ -n "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_RUN_DIR:-}" ]] && RUN_DIR="${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_RUN_DIR}"
fi

if [[ ! -r "$LEDGER" ]]; then
  echo "[DECISIONS] WARNING: the decision ledger is unreadable at grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml; the surface is enabled but degraded."
  exit 0
fi
doc="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$LEDGER" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -z "$doc" ]] || ! printf '%s' "$doc" | jq -e '.schema_version == 1 and ((.decisions // []) | type == "array")' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[DECISIONS] WARNING: grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml does not parse or has an unknown schema_version; the surface is enabled but degraded."
  exit 0
fi

# Rows: proposed first, then open; fields reduced to a safe id, the status and a cleaned summary.
rows="$(printf '%s' "$doc" | jq -r '
  def clean: tostring | gsub("[[:cntrl:]\u0080-\u009f  ]"; " ") | gsub("<"; "‹") | gsub(">"; "›")
             | gsub("`"; "‘") | gsub("  +"; " ") | sub("^ "; "") | sub(" $"; "");
  def cap: if length > 100 then .[0:99] + "…" else . end;
  [ (.decisions // [])[] | objects | select(.status == "proposed" or .status == "open") ]
  | (map(select(.status == "proposed")) + map(select(.status == "open"))) as $r
  | "C\t\($r | map(select(.status == "proposed")) | length)\t\($r | map(select(.status == "open")) | length)",
    ($r[0:10][] | "R\t\((.id // "") | tostring | gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9-]"; "") | .[0:16])\t\(.status)\t\((.summary // "") | clean | cap)")
' 2>/dev/null || true)"

n_prop=0; n_open=0; lines=()
while IFS=$'\t' read -r kind a b c; do
  case "$kind" in
    C) n_prop="$a"; n_open="$b" ;;
    R) lines+=("- ${a} ${b}: ${c}") ;;
  esac
done <<< "$rows"

# Stale unattended marker (the writer ignores it; the notice tells the operator to clear it).
stale_note=""
marker="${RUN_DIR}/unattended.json"
if [[ -f "$marker" ]]; then
  ttl="$(yq '.decisions.unattended_marker_ttl_hours // 24' "$config_path" 2>/dev/null || echo 24)"
  [[ "$ttl" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$ttl" -gt 0 ]] || ttl=24
  sid="$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$marker" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  ca="$(jq -r '.created_at // empty' "$marker" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  ep=""
  if [[ -n "$ca" ]]; then
    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    ep="$( (source "${REPO_ROOT}/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; _date_to_epoch "$ca") 2>/dev/null || true)"
  fi
  sess="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}}"
  if [[ ! "$ep" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( $(date -u +%s) - ep > ttl * 3600 )) || [[ -n "$sess" && -n "$sid" && "$sid" != "$sess" ]]; then
    stale_note="[DECISIONS] .run/unattended.json is stale (other session or older than ${ttl} h): ignored; clear it with /decisions clear-unattended"
  fi
fi

total=$(( n_prop + n_open ))
[[ "$total" -gt 0 || -n "$stale_note" ]] || exit 0

block="$(
  if [[ "$total" -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "[DECISIONS] ${n_prop} proposed, ${n_open} open (grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml):"
    printf '%s\n' "${lines[@]}"
    if [[ "$total" -gt 10 ]]; then echo "... and $(( total - 10 )) more: dec-write-lib.sh list --status proposed,open"; fi
  fi
  [[ -z "$stale_note" ]] || echo "$stale_note"
  if [[ "$n_prop" -gt 0 ]]; then echo "Confirm proposed rows with /decisions confirm."; fi
)"

fenced="$( (source "${REPO_ROOT}/.claude/scripts/lib/context-isolation-lib.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
            && sanitize_for_session_start L6 "$block" --max-chars 2000) 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ "$fenced" == *"<untrusted-content"* ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$fenced"
else
  echo "[DECISIONS] WARNING: ${n_prop} proposed, ${n_open} open; the L6 sanitizer is unavailable, so rows are not shown. Run: .claude/scripts/lib/dec-write-lib.sh list --status proposed,open"
fi
exit 0

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# dec-write-lib.sh: the single writer of the decision ledger grimoires/loa/decisions.yaml
4	#
5	# Rows are append-only (schema: grimoires/loa/sdd.md §3.1, docs/architecture/decision-lineage.md).
6	# Every write takes the lock, copies the ledger to a temp file beside it, applies the change with
7	# yq v4 (values reach yq only through env(); rows are built by jq --arg), VERIFIES the temp (it
8	# parses, no id dropped or repeated, the row count moves by exactly the operation's rows, every
9	# other row JSON-equal, and validate-artifact.sh --type decisions --base-file <current> passes),
10	# then renames it over the ledger. Any failure deletes the temp and leaves the ledger untouched.
11	#
12	# Attribution is derived, never passed: no caller sets decided_by. Skills write `open` or
13	# `proposed` rows with proposed_by agent (flatline|dissent only interactively, with an existing
14	# artifact whose sha256 is recorded). In an unattended context (`context` below) every write lands
15	# `proposed` (an explicit --status open stays open: an open question, not a decision taken),
16	# proposed_by is agent, and --answer-ref / --as are ignored with a WARN. Only the operator-only
17	# /decisions command passes --recorded-by decisions-command, the one caller of `confirm`, of
18	# `reject`/`supersede` on a decided row and of `context --clear`.
19	#
20	# A linked worktree (git-common-dir differs from git-dir) or --pending writes
21	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-<N>/decisions-pending.yaml with PEND-<8 hex> ids; `import` in the
22	# main checkout allocates the real DEC ids. Live-ledger writes exit 1 under CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS
23	# or LOA_HOOK_CONTEXT=1 (--file fixtures are exempt so the suites run in CI).
24	#
25	# Ops:
26	#   new        --summary S --phase P --category C --recorded-by R --source SRC
27	#              [--status open|proposed] [--decision D --rationale W --alternative-json J ...]
28	#              [--consequence-pos X ...] [--consequence-neg X ...] [--answer-ref REF]
29	#              [--as flatline|dissent] [--cycle C] [--evidence E] [--pending] [--sprint N]
30	#   decide     --id ID --decision D --rationale W --alternative-json J ... --evidence E --recorded-by R
31	#              [--answer-ref REF] [--consequence-pos X ...] [--consequence-neg X ...]
32	#   confirm    --recorded-by decisions-command --evidence E (--id ID ... | --cycle C [--all])
33	#              [--answer-ref REF]                                   (/decisions only)
34	#   reject     --id ID --rationale W --follow-up F --recorded-by R [--prior-request X ...]
35	#   supersede  --id OLD plus the `new` flags (decision, rationale, alternatives required)
36	#   import     --from PENDING [--rewrite PATH ...]                   (main checkout only)
37	#   list       [--status S,..] [--voice V,..] [--decided-by V,..] [--not-decided-by V,..]
38	#              [--cycle C] [--since ISO] [--source-prefix P] [--source-epic SLUG] [--id ID ...]
39	#              [--format tsv|md|json]                               (read-only)
40	#   context    [--why] [--prd PATH] | --set-unattended --reason R | --clear --recorded-by decisions-command
41	# Common: --file PATH (target override), --quiet
42	# Exit: 0 ok; 1 refused (preflight, CI/hook context, lock busy, verify, validation, unknown id,
43	#       illegal transition, ref grammar, missing artifact, ambiguous confirm); 2 usage.
44	# =============================================================================
45	export LC_ALL=C
46	set -euo pipefail
47	
48	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
49	PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../.." && pwd -P)"
50	G="${PROJECT_ROOT}/grimoires/loa"
51	LIVE="${G}/decisions.yaml"
52	VALIDATOR="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
53	OPERATOR_CMD="decisions-command"
54	QUIET=0
55	TMPF=""
56	MKLOCK=""
57	SCRATCH=""
58	# shellcheck source=/dev/null
59	source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../compat-lib.sh"
60	
61	release_mklock(){ [[ -n "$MKLOCK" ]] || return 0; rm -f "${MKLOCK}/pid" 2>/dev/null; rmdir "$MKLOCK" 2>/dev/null; MKLOCK=""; return 0; }
62	cleanup(){ [[ -n "$TMPF" ]] && rm -f "$TMPF" 2>/dev/null; [[ -n "$SCRATCH" ]] && rm -f "$SCRATCH".old "$SCRATCH".new "$SCRATCH" 2>/dev/null; release_mklock; return 0; }
63	trap cleanup EXIT
64	
65	log(){ [[ $QUIET -eq 0 ]] && echo "$@" >&2 || true; }
66	warn(){ echo "dec-write: WARN: $*" >&2; }
67	die(){ echo "dec-write: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
68	usage(){ echo "dec-write: usage: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
69	
70	# Single-line scalar, identical to kf-write-lib.sh san1(): strip control bytes, C1 controls and
71	# U+2028/U+2029 (as their UTF-8 bytes under LC_ALL=C), flatten whitespace, trim.
72	DEC_ULB_RE="$(printf '\302[\200-\237]|\342\200[\250\251]')"
73	san1(){ printf '%s' "${1-}" | tr -d '\000-\010\013\014\016-\037\177' | tr '\t\n\r' '   ' | sed -E "s/${DEC_ULB_RE}/ /g"' ; s/  +/ /g; s/^ //; s/ $//'; }
74	
75	# ---- arg parsing (bash 3.2 safe: no associative arrays; values stored as O_<key>) ----
76	BOOL_KEYS=" quiet all pending why set-unattended clear "
77	MULTI_KEYS=" id alternative-json consequence-pos consequence-neg rewrite prior-request "
78	KNOWN_KEYS=" file summary phase category recorded-by source status decision rationale answer-ref as cycle evidence sprint follow-up from format voice decided-by not-decided-by since source-prefix source-epic reason prd "
79	US=$'\037'
80	o(){ local n="O_${1//-/_}"; printf '%s' "${!n-}"; }
81	has(){ local n="O_${1//-/_}"; [[ -n "${!n+x}" ]]; }
82	# Print each value of a repeatable flag as a NUL-terminated record.
83	om(){
84	  local n="O_${1//-/_}" v rest
85	  [[ -n "${!n+x}" ]] || return 0
86	  v="${!n}"
87	  while :; do
88	    if [[ "$v" == *"$US"* ]]; then printf '%s\0' "${v%%"$US"*}"; v="${v#*"$US"}"; else printf '%s\0' "$v"; break; fi
89	  done
90	}
91	CMD="${1:-}"; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift || true
92	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
93	  case "$1" in
94	    --*)
95	      k="${1#--}"; shift
96	      [[ "$k" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ ]] || usage "bad flag --$k"
97	      if [[ "$BOOL_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]]; then printf -v "O_${k//-/_}" '%s' 1; continue; fi
98	      [[ "$MULTI_KEYS" == *" $k "* || "$KNOWN_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]] || usage "unknown flag --$k (see --help)"
99	      [[ $# -gt 0 ]] || usage "--$k needs a value"
100	      v="$1"; shift
101	      if [[ "$MULTI_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]]; then
102	        n="O_${k//-/_}"
103	        if [[ -n "${!n+x}" ]]; then printf -v "$n" '%s' "${!n}${US}${v}"; else printf -v "$n" '%s' "$v"; fi
104	      else
105	        printf -v "O_${k//-/_}" '%s' "$v"
106	      fi ;;
107	    *) usage "unexpected argument: $1" ;;
108	  esac
109	done
110	has quiet && QUIET=1
111	
112	# ---- environment -------------------------------------------------------------
113	session_id(){ local s="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}}"; s="$(printf '%s' "$s" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_.-')"; printf '%s' "${s:-unknown-session}"; }
114	now_utc(){ date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }
115	
116	abs_dir(){ (cd "$1" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); }
117	# Main checkout root when PROJECT_ROOT is a linked worktree; empty otherwise.
118	MAIN_ROOT=""
119	IS_WORKTREE=0
120	detect_worktree(){
121	  command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
122	  local gd cd
123	  gd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
124	  cd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
125	  gd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && abs_dir "$gd")"; cd="$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" && abs_dir "$cd")"
126	  if [[ -n "$gd" && -n "$cd" && "$gd" != "$cd" ]]; then
127	    IS_WORKTREE=1
128	    MAIN_ROOT="$(dirname "$cd")"
129	  fi
130	  return 0
131	}
132	detect_worktree
133	
134	# Run-state directories: this checkout's .run, plus the main checkout's when this is a worktree.
135	run_dirs(){ printf '%s\n' "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run"; [[ -n "$MAIN_ROOT" ]] && printf '%s\n' "${MAIN_ROOT}/.run"; return 0; }
136	
137	ttl_hours(){
138	  local t="" cfg="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.loa.config.yaml"
139	  if [[ -f "$cfg" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
140	    t="$(yq '.decisions.unattended_marker_ttl_hours // ""' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null || true)"
141	  fi
142	  [[ "$t" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$t" -gt 0 ]] || t=24
143	  printf '%s' "$t"
144	}
145	
146	# fresh | stale | absent for one marker file.
147	marker_state(){
148	  local f="$1" sid ca ep now sess
149	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || { echo absent; return 0; }
150	  sid="$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
151	  ca="$(jq -r '.created_at // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
152	  [[ -n "$ca" ]] || { echo stale; return 0; }
153	  ep="$(_date_to_epoch "$ca" 2>/dev/null || true)"
154	  [[ "$ep" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo stale; return 0; }
155	  now="$(date -u +%s)"
156	  if (( now - ep > $(ttl_hours) * 3600 )); then echo stale; return 0; fi
157	  sess="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}}"
158	  if [[ -n "$sess" && -n "$sid" && "$sid" != "$sess" ]]; then echo stale; return 0; fi
159	  echo fresh
160	}
161	
162	PRD_PATH=""
163	# Print one line per active unattended signal: "<kind> <detail>"; kind live|prd.
164	ctx_signals(){
165	  local d f st
166	  while IFS= read -r d; do
167	    [[ -n "$d" ]] || continue
168	    if [[ "$(marker_state "$d/unattended.json")" == "fresh" ]]; then echo "live unattended-marker:${d}/unattended.json"; fi
169	    for f in "$d/sprint-plan-state.json" "$d/state.json"; do
170	      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
171	      st="$(jq -r '.state // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
172	      if [[ "$st" == "RUNNING" ]]; then echo "live run-state:${f}"; fi
173	    done
174	  done < <(run_dirs)
175	  if [[ "${LOA_UNATTENDED:-}" == "1" ]]; then echo "live env:LOA_UNATTENDED=1"; fi
176	  if [[ "${LOA_FLATLINE_MODE:-}" == "autonomous" ]]; then echo "live env:LOA_FLATLINE_MODE=autonomous"; fi
177	  local prd="${PRD_PATH:-${G}/prd.md}"
178	  if [[ -f "$prd" ]] && grep -m1 -E '^\*\*Status:?\*\*:?' "$prd" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE 'autonomous|unattended'; then
179	    echo "prd prd-status:${prd}"
180	  fi
181	  return 0

200	# ---- lock (flock -w when present, else a mkdir lock with a stale check) ------
201	LOCK_WAIT="${LOA_DEC_LOCK_WAIT:-10}"
202	[[ "$LOCK_WAIT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$LOCK_WAIT" -ge 1 && "$LOCK_WAIT" -le 10 ]] || LOCK_WAIT=10
203	lock_path(){ # target -> lock file under .run, keyed by the target's absolute path
204	  local abs h
205	  abs="$(abs_dir "$(dirname "$1")")/$(basename "$1")"
206	  h="$(printf '%s' "$abs" | sha256_portable | cut -c1-12)"
207	  printf '%s' "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run/.dec-write-${h}.lock"

209	acquire_lock(){ # target
210	  local lp; lp="$(lock_path "$1")"
211	  mkdir -p "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run"
212	  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ "${LOA_DEC_NO_FLOCK:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
213	    exec 9>"$lp"
214	    flock -w "$LOCK_WAIT" 9 || die "lock busy: another writer holds ${lp} (waited ${LOCK_WAIT}s); retry"
215	    return 0
216	  fi
217	  local d="${lp}.d" tries=$(( LOCK_WAIT * 10 )) pid
218	  while ! mkdir "$d" 2>/dev/null; do
219	    pid="$(cat "$d/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)"
220	    # Stale: older than 60 s and its owner is gone.
221	    if [[ -n "$(find "$d" -maxdepth 0 -mmin +1 2>/dev/null)" ]] && { [[ -z "$pid" ]] || ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; }; then
222	      rm -f "$d/pid" 2>/dev/null; rmdir "$d" 2>/dev/null || true; continue
223	    fi
224	    tries=$(( tries - 1 ))
225	    (( tries > 0 )) || die "lock busy: another writer holds ${d} (waited ${LOCK_WAIT}s); retry"
226	    sleep 0.1
227	  done
228	  MKLOCK="$d"
229	  printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$d/pid"
230	}

318	  if [[ -n "$as" ]]; then
319	    [[ "$allow_as" == "1" ]] || die "--as is set once, at creation (proposed_by is immutable)"
320	    [[ "$as" == "flatline" || "$as" == "dissent" ]] || usage "--as must be flatline or dissent"
321	    [[ "$ref" == "${as}:"* ]] || die "--as ${as} needs --answer-ref ${as}:<artifact path>"

392	# verify_and_swap OLD_JSON ADDED TOUCHED_IDS_JSON
393	verify_and_swap(){
394	  local old="$1" added="$2" touched="$3" errs
395	  # Whole-ledger JSON goes through files (--slurpfile): a large ledger overflows one argv string.
396	  SCRATCH="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dec-verify.XXXXXX")"
397	  printf '%s' "$old" > "${SCRATCH}.old"
398	  yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$TMPF" > "${SCRATCH}.new" 2>/dev/null || die "ABORT: the candidate ledger does not parse; ledger untouched"
399	  errs="$(jq -rn --slurpfile O "${SCRATCH}.old" --slurpfile N "${SCRATCH}.new" --argjson added "$added" --argjson t "$touched" '
400	    $O[0] as $o | $N[0] as $n
401	    | ($o.decisions | map(.id)) as $oi | (($n.decisions // []) | map(.id)) as $ni
402	    | (($n.decisions // []) | map(select(type == "object" and (.id | type) == "string") | {key: .id, value: .}) | from_entries) as $nb
403	    | ($oi | map({key: ., value: true}) | from_entries) as $os | ($t | map({key: ., value: true}) | from_entries) as $ts
404	    | [ (if $n.schema_version != 1 then "unknown schema_version" else empty end),
405	        (if ($n.decisions | type) != "array" then "decisions is not a sequence" else empty end),
406	        ($oi - $ni | .[] | "would drop id \(.)"),
407	        ($ni | group_by(.) | map(select(length > 1) | .[0]) | .[] | "duplicate id \(.)"),
408	        (if ($ni | length) != (($o.decisions | length) + $added) then "row count \($ni | length) != \($o.decisions | length) + \($added)" else empty end),
409	        ($o.decisions[] as $r | select($ts[$r.id] | not) | select($nb[$r.id] != $r) | "row \($r.id) changed outside this operation"),
410	        ($n.decisions[] | .id as $x | select($os[$x] | not) | select($ts[$x] | not) | "unexpected new row \($x)")
411	      ] | .[]')" || die "ABORT: verification failed to run; ledger untouched"
412	  [[ -z "$errs" ]] || die "ABORT: ${errs//$'\n'/; }; ledger untouched"
413	  [[ -f "$VALIDATOR" ]] || die "ABORT: validator missing at ${VALIDATOR}; ledger untouched"
414	  local vout
415	  if ! vout="$(PROJECT_ROOT="$PROJECT_ROOT" bash "$VALIDATOR" --type decisions --file "$TMPF" --base-file "$TARGET" 2>&1)"; then
416	    die "ABORT: the candidate fails validate-artifact.sh --type decisions; ledger untouched:"$'\n'"$vout"
417	  fi
418	  chmod 0644 "$TMPF"
419	  mv -f "$TMPF" "$TARGET"; TMPF=""
420	}

424	# Build a new row JSON. Args: id status voice ref sha supersedes
425	build_row(){
426	  local id="$1" status="$2" voice="$3" ref="$4" sha="$5" sup="$6"
427	  local summary phase category source decision rationale alts cons rb cyc now ev
428	  summary="$(san1 "$(o summary)")"; phase="$(san1 "$(o phase)")"; category="$(san1 "$(o category)")"; source="$(san1 "$(o source)")"
429	  [[ -n "$summary" ]] || usage "--summary is required"
430	  # characters, not bytes (LC_ALL=C makes ${#x} a byte count): the validator's limit is 160 code points
431	  [[ "$(jq -rn --arg s "$summary" '$s | length')" -le 160 ]] || die "--summary is over 160 characters; one plain line"
432	  [[ "$phase" =~ ^(discovery|architecture|sprint-planning|implementation|review|charting|spike|operations)$ ]] || usage "--phase must be discovery|architecture|sprint-planning|implementation|review|charting|spike|operations"
433	  [[ "$category" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ ]] || usage "--category must match [a-z][a-z0-9-]* (e.g. scope, technology, architecture)"
434	  [[ -n "$source" ]] || usage "--source is required (bead id, PR, NOTES anchor, spike path, with a line or anchor)"
435	  decision="$(san1 "$(o decision)")"; rationale="$(san1 "$(o rationale)")"; alts="$(alts_json)"; cons="$(cons_json)"
436	  if [[ "$status" == "proposed" ]]; then
437	    [[ -n "$decision" && -n "$rationale" && "$(printf '%s' "$alts" | jq 'length')" -ge 1 ]] \
438	      || die "a proposed row needs --decision, --rationale and at least one --alternative-json"
439	  fi
440	  rb="$(recorded_by)"; cyc="$(san1 "$(o cycle)")"; [[ -n "$cyc" ]] || cyc="$(default_cycle)"
441	  if [[ -z "$cyc" ]] && is_unattended; then warn "no cycle id (pass --cycle); the row's cycle is null"; fi
442	  now="$(now_utc)"; ev="$(san1 "$(o evidence)")"; [[ -n "$ev" ]] || ev="$source"
443	  jq -cn --arg id "$id" --arg now "$now" --arg phase "$phase" --arg category "$category" --arg summary "$summary" \
444	    --arg decision "$decision" --arg rationale "$rationale" --argjson alts "$alts" --argjson cons "$cons" \
445	    --arg voice "$voice" --arg ref "$ref" --arg sha "$sha" --arg rb "${rb}/$(session_id)" --arg by "${voice}:${rb}" \
446	    --arg commit "$(head_commit)" --arg source "$source" --arg cycle "$cyc" --arg sup "$sup" --arg status "$status" --arg ev "$ev" '
447	    def n: if . == "" then null else . end;
448	    {id: $id, created_at: $now, updated_at: $now, phase: $phase, category: $category, summary: $summary,
449	     decision: ($decision | n), rationale: ($rationale | n),
450	     alternatives_considered: (if ($alts | length) == 0 then null else $alts end), consequences: $cons,
451	     proposed_by: $voice, decided_by: null, decided_by_ref: ($ref | n), evidence_sha256: ($sha | n),
452	     recorded_by: $rb, commit: $commit, source: $source, cycle: ($cycle | n), supersedes: ($sup | n),
453	     supersede_proposed_by: null, status: $status,
454	     transitions: [{at: $now, from: null, to: $status, by: $by, evidence: $ev}],
455	     rejection_rationale: null, follow_up: null, prior_requests: []}'
456	}

499	      | .status = "proposed" | .updated_at = $now

510	  local ev; ev="$(san1 "$(o evidence)")"; [[ -n "$ev" ]] || die "confirm: --evidence is required (e.g. cli:<iso-8601>)"
511	  resolve_target write
512	  [[ "$TARGET_KIND" != "pending" ]] || die "confirm runs on the live ledger in the main checkout, never on a pending file"
513	  derive_attribution 0
514	  acquire_lock "$TARGET"
515	  local old id cyc; old="$(read_ledger "$TARGET")"
516	  local -a ids=()
517	  while IFS= read -r -d '' id; do id="$(san1 "$id")"; [[ "$id" =~ ^DEC-[0-9]{4,}$ ]] || usage "confirm: bad --id $id"; ids+=("$id"); done < <(om id)
518	  cyc="$(san1 "$(o cycle)")"
519	  if [[ ${#ids[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
520	    [[ -n "$cyc" ]] || usage "confirm needs --id DEC-NNNN ... or --cycle <cycle> [--all]"
521	    local matches; matches="$(printf '%s' "$old" | jq -r --arg c "$cyc" '.decisions[] | select(.status == "proposed" and .cycle == $c) | .id')"
522	    [[ -n "$matches" ]] || die "confirm: no proposed rows in cycle ${cyc}"
523	    if [[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$matches" | grep -c .)" -gt 1 ]] && ! has all; then
524	      echo "confirm --cycle ${cyc} matches these proposed rows:" >&2
525	      printf '%s' "$old" | jq -r --arg c "$cyc" '.decisions[] | select(.status == "proposed" and .cycle == $c) | "  \(.id) \(.summary)"' >&2
526	      die "confirm: more than one row matches; pass --all or explicit --id values"
527	    fi
528	    while IFS= read -r id; do [[ -z "$id" ]] || ids+=("$id"); done <<< "$matches"
529	  fi
530	  local touched="[]" r now sup so cur="$old"; now="$(now_utc)"
531	  begin_tmp
532	  for id in "${ids[@]}"; do
533	    r="$(row_by_id "$cur" "$id")"; [[ -n "$r" ]] || die "confirm: unknown id ${id}"
534	    [[ "$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.status')" == "proposed" ]] || die "confirm: ${id} is $(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.status'), not proposed (illegal transition)"
535	    echo "confirming ${id}: $(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.summary')" >&2
536	    r="$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -c --arg ref "$REF" --arg now "$now" --arg by "operator:${OPERATOR_CMD}" --arg ev "$ev" --arg opre "$OPREF_RE" '
537	        .decided_by_ref = (if .decided_by_ref == null and $ref != "" then $ref else .decided_by_ref end)
538	        | .decided_by = (if ((.decided_by_ref // "") | test($opre)) then "operator" else .proposed_by end)
539	        | .status = "decided" | .updated_at = $now
540	        | .transitions += [{at: $now, from: "proposed", to: "decided", by: $by, evidence: $ev}]')"
541	    replace_row "$r"
542	    touched="$(jq -cn --argjson t "$touched" --arg i "$id" '$t + [$i]')"
543	    # An agent-proposed supersede: the old decided row moves to superseded when its replacement is confirmed.
544	    sup="$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.supersedes // empty')"
545	    if [[ -n "$sup" ]]; then
546	      so="$(row_by_id "$cur" "$sup")"
547	      if [[ -n "$so" ]] && [[ "$(printf '%s' "$so" | jq -r '.status + "|" + (.supersede_proposed_by // "")')" == "decided|${id}" ]]; then
548	        so="$(printf '%s' "$so" | jq -c --arg now "$now" --arg by "operator:${OPERATOR_CMD}" --arg ev "$ev" --arg n "$id" '
549	            .status = "superseded" | .updated_at = $now | .transitions += [{at: $now, from: "decided", to: "superseded", by: $by, evidence: ("superseded by " + $n + "; " + $ev)}]')"
550	        replace_row "$so"
551	        touched="$(jq -cn --argjson t "$touched" --arg i "$sup" '$t + [$i]')"
552	      fi
553	    fi
554	    cur="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$TMPF")"
555	  done
556	  verify_and_swap "$old" 0 "$touched"
557	  log "dec-write: confirmed ${ids[*]}"
558	}
559	
560	op_reject(){
561	  preflight
562	  local id; id="$(need_id)"
563	  local rat fu; rat="$(san1 "$(o rationale)")"; fu="$(san1 "$(o follow-up)")"
564	  [[ -n "$rat" ]] || die "reject: --rationale is required"
565	  [[ -n "$fu" ]] || die "reject: --follow-up is required (a bead id or NOTES anchor, so the correction propagates)"
566	  resolve_target write
567	  acquire_lock "$TARGET"
568	  local old r st rb by; old="$(read_ledger "$TARGET")"; r="$(row_by_id "$old" "$id")"
569	  [[ -n "$r" ]] || die "reject: unknown id ${id}"
570	  st="$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.status')"; rb="$(recorded_by)"
571	  case "$st" in
572	    open|proposed) if is_operator_call && ! is_unattended; then by="operator:${OPERATOR_CMD}"; else by="agent:${rb}"; fi ;;
573	    decided)
574	      is_operator_call || die "reject: ${id} is decided; only the operator rejects it through /decisions. Propose the reversal with: dec-write-lib.sh supersede --id ${id} ... (lands proposed)"
575	      if is_unattended; then die "reject: ${id} is decided and the context is unattended; the operator rejects it interactively"; fi
576	      by="operator:${OPERATOR_CMD}" ;;
577	    *) die "reject: ${id} is ${st} (illegal transition)" ;;
578	  esac
579	  local pr now; pr="$(str_list_json prior-request)"; now="$(now_utc)"
580	  r="$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -c --arg rat "$rat" --arg fu "$fu" --argjson pr "$pr" --arg now "$now" --arg by "$by" --arg st "$st" '
581	      .rejection_rationale = $rat | .follow_up = $fu | .prior_requests = ((.prior_requests // []) + $pr)
582	      | .status = "rejected" | .updated_at = $now
583	      | .transitions += [{at: $now, from: $st, to: "rejected", by: $by, evidence: $rat}]')"
584	  begin_tmp; replace_row "$r"
585	  verify_and_swap "$old" 0 "$(jq -cn --arg i "$id" '[$i]')"
586	  log "dec-write: ${id} ${st} -> rejected"
587	}
588	
589	op_supersede(){
590	  preflight
591	  local oid; oid="$(need_id)"
592	  resolve_target write
593	  [[ "$TARGET_KIND" != "pending" ]] || die "supersede runs in the main checkout against the live ledger (the old row lives there)"
594	  derive_attribution 1
595	  acquire_lock "$TARGET"
596	  local old r st; old="$(read_ledger "$TARGET")"; r="$(row_by_id "$old" "$oid")"
597	  [[ -n "$r" ]] || die "supersede: unknown id ${oid}"
598	  st="$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.status')"
599	  [[ "$st" == "decided" ]] || die "supersede: ${oid} is ${st}; only a decided row is superseded (reject an open or proposed row instead)"
600	  if ! { is_operator_call && ! is_unattended; }; then
601	    [[ -z "$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.supersede_proposed_by // empty')" ]] || die "supersede: a replacement is already proposed for ${oid}: $(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -r '.supersede_proposed_by')"
602	  fi
603	  local nid row now; nid="$(next_dec_id "$old")"; now="$(now_utc)"
604	  row="$(build_row "$nid" "proposed" "$VOICE" "$REF" "$SHA" "$oid")"
605	  begin_tmp; append_row "$row"
606	  if is_operator_call && ! is_unattended; then
607	    r="$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -c --arg now "$now" --arg by "operator:${OPERATOR_CMD}" --arg n "$nid" '
608	        .status = "superseded" | .updated_at = $now | .transitions += [{at: $now, from: "decided", to: "superseded", by: $by, evidence: ("superseded by " + $n)}]')"
609	  else
610	    r="$(printf '%s' "$r" | jq -c --arg now "$now" --arg n "$nid" '.supersede_proposed_by = $n | .updated_at = $now')"
611	  fi
612	  replace_row "$r"
613	  verify_and_swap "$old" 1 "$(jq -cn --arg a "$oid" --arg b "$nid" '[$a, $b]')"
614	  log "dec-write: ${nid} proposed to supersede ${oid}"
615	  echo "$nid"
616	}
617	
618	op_import(){
619	  preflight
620	  local from; from="$(o from)"; [[ -n "$from" ]] || usage "import --from <pending file> required"
621	  [[ -f "$from" ]] || die "import: pending file not found: $from"
622	  if has file; then resolve_target write; else
623	    [[ $IS_WORKTREE -eq 0 ]] || die "import runs in the main checkout (this is a linked worktree)"
624	    local why; if why="$(ci_blocked)"; then die "refused: ${why} is set"; fi
625	    TARGET="$LIVE"; TARGET_KIND="live"; [[ -f "$TARGET" ]] || die "ledger not found: $TARGET"
626	  fi
627	  local pv; pv="$(PROJECT_ROOT="$PROJECT_ROOT" bash "$VALIDATOR" --type decisions --file "$from" 2>&1)" || die "import: the pending file fails validation:"$'\n'"$pv"
628	  acquire_lock "$TARGET"
629	  local old pend n; old="$(read_ledger "$TARGET")"; pend="$(read_ledger "$from")"
630	  n="$(printf '%s' "$pend" | jq '.decisions | length')"
631	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || die "import: no rows in $from"
632	  # Allocate ids in file order, then rewrite every PEND reference inside the imported rows.
633	  local map="{}" pid i next cur="$old"
634	  for (( i = 0; i < n; i++ )); do
635	    pid="$(printf '%s' "$pend" | jq -r --argjson i "$i" '.decisions[$i].id')"
636	    [[ "$pid" =~ ^PEND-[0-9a-f]{8}$ ]] || die "import: row $i has id $pid, not PEND-<8 hex>"
637	    next="$(next_dec_id "$cur")"
638	    map="$(jq -cn --argjson m "$map" --arg p "$pid" --arg d "$next" '$m + {($p): $d}')"
639	    cur="$(printf '%s' "$cur" | jq -c --arg d "$next" '.decisions += [{id: $d}]')"
640	  done
641	  begin_tmp
642	  local rows touched r; rows="$(printf '%s' "$pend" | jq -c --argjson m "$map" '
643	      def rw: reduce ($m | to_entries[]) as $e (.; gsub($e.key; $e.value));
644	      .decisions[] | walk(if type == "string" then rw else . end)')"
645	  touched="$(jq -cn --argjson m "$map" '[$m[]]')"
646	  while IFS= read -r r; do [[ -z "$r" ]] || append_row "$r"; done <<< "$rows"
647	  verify_and_swap "$old" "$n" "$touched"
648	  local p tmp2
649	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
650	    [[ -f "$p" ]] || { warn "import: --rewrite target not found: $p"; continue; }
651	    tmp2="$(mktemp "${p}.XXXXXX")"
652	    printf '%s' "$map" | jq -r 'to_entries[] | "\(.key)\t\(.value)"' | awk -F'\t' 'NR == FNR { m[$1] = $2; next } { for (k in m) gsub(k, m[k]); print }' - "$p" > "$tmp2"
653	    chmod 0644 "$tmp2"; mv -f "$tmp2" "$p"
654	  done < <(om rewrite)
655	  rm -f -- "$from"
656	  printf '%s' "$map" | jq -r 'to_entries[] | "\(.key) \(.value)"'
657	  log "dec-write: imported ${n} row(s) from ${from}; pending file removed. A bead whose external_ref holds a PEND id: br update <bead> --external-ref <DEC id> (beads stay with the lead)"
658	}
659	
660	op_list(){
661	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "list: jq is required"
662	  command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "list: Mike Farah yq v4 is required"
663	  resolve_target read
664	  local fmt; fmt="$(o format)"; fmt="${fmt:-tsv}"
665	  [[ "$fmt" =~ ^(tsv|md|json)$ ]] || usage "--format must be tsv, md or json"
666	  local j
667	  if [[ ! -f "$TARGET" ]]; then j='{"schema_version":1,"decisions":[]}'; else
668	    j="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$TARGET" 2>/dev/null)" || die "list: unparsable ledger ${TARGET}"
669	    printf '%s' "$j" | jq -e '.schema_version == 1' >/dev/null 2>&1 || warn "list: unknown schema_version in ${TARGET}"
670	    printf '%s' "$j" | jq -e '(.decisions // []) | type == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "list: no decisions sequence in ${TARGET}"
671	  fi
672	  local voice; voice="$(o voice)"; [[ -n "$voice" ]] || voice="$(o decided-by)"
673	  local ids; ids="$(om id | tr '\0' ',')"
674	  printf '%s' "$j" | jq -r --arg fmt "$fmt" --arg st "$(o status)" --arg vo "$voice" --arg nv "$(o not-decided-by)" \
675	    --arg cy "$(o cycle)" --arg since "$(o since)" --arg sp "$(o source-prefix)" --arg se "$(o source-epic)" --arg ids "$ids" '
676	    def csv: if . == "" then [] else split(",") | map(select(length > 0)) end;
677	    def cl: tostring | gsub("[[:cntrl:]]"; " ");
678	    def mc: cl | gsub("\\|"; "\\|");
679	    ($st | csv) as $S | ($vo | csv) as $V | ($nv | csv) as $NV | ($ids | csv) as $I
680	    | [ (.decisions // [])[]
681	        | (.decided_by // .proposed_by // "") as $voice | (.status // "") as $status | (.id // "") as $id
682	        | select(($S | length) == 0 or ($S | index($status)))
683	        | select(($V | length) == 0 or ($V | index($voice)))
684	        | select(($NV | length) == 0 or (($NV | index($voice)) | not))
685	        | select($cy == "" or .cycle == $cy)
686	        | select($since == "" or ((.created_at // "") >= $since))
687	        | select($sp == "" or ((.source // "") | startswith($sp)))
688	        | select($se == "" or ((.source // "") | startswith("map:" + $se + "/")))
689	        | select(($I | length) == 0 or ($I | index($id)))
690	        | . + {voice: $voice} ] as $rows
691	    | if $fmt == "json" then ($rows | tojson)
692	      elif $fmt == "tsv" then ($rows[] | [.id, .status, .voice, (.summary // ""), (.source // "")] | map(cl) | join("\t"))
693	      else
694	        if ($rows | length) == 0 then "_None: every decision in this run was the operator'"'"'s._"
695	        else ("| Decision | Voice | Status | Why | Source |", "|---|---|---|---|---|",
696	              ($rows[] | "| \((.summary // "") | mc) (\(.id)) | \(.voice | mc) | \(.status | mc) | \((.rationale // "") | mc) | \((.source // "") | mc) |"),
697	              "Confirm with /decisions confirm.")
698	        end
699	      end'
700	}
701	
702	op_context(){
703	  PRD_PATH="$(o prd)"
704	  if has set-unattended; then
705	    local reason; reason="$(san1 "$(o reason)")"; [[ -n "$reason" ]] || usage "context --set-unattended needs --reason"
706	    command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "context: jq is required"
707	    mkdir -p "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run"
708	    local m="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run/unattended.json" t
709	    t="$(mktemp "${m}.XXXXXX")"
710	    jq -n --arg r "$reason" --arg s "$(session_id)" --arg c "$(now_utc)" '{reason: $r, session_id: $s, created_at: $c}' > "$t"
711	    mv -f "$t" "$m"
712	    log "dec-write: unattended marker written (${m#"${PROJECT_ROOT}/"}); it expires after $(ttl_hours) h or when the session changes"
713	    echo unattended; return 0
714	  fi
715	  if has clear; then
716	    is_operator_call || die "context --clear runs only from the operator-only /decisions command (--recorded-by ${OPERATOR_CMD})"
717	    local mk="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.run/unattended.json"
718	    rm -f -- "$mk"
719	    log "dec-write: unattended marker cleared"
720	  fi
721	  local sig; sig="$(ctx_signals)"
722	  if [[ -n "$sig" ]]; then echo unattended; else echo interactive; fi
723	  if has why; then
724	    if [[ -n "$sig" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$sig" | sed 's/^/signal: /'; else echo "signal: none"; fi
725	    local d ms; while IFS= read -r d; do ms="$(marker_state "$d/unattended.json")"; if [[ "$ms" == "stale" ]]; then echo "note: stale marker ignored: $d/unattended.json"; fi; done < <(run_dirs)
726	  fi
727	  return 0
728	}
729	
730	case "$CMD" in
731	  new) op_new ;;
732	  decide) op_decide ;;
733	  confirm) op_confirm ;;
734	  reject) op_reject ;;
735	  supersede) op_supersede ;;
736	  import) op_import ;;
737	  list) op_list ;;
738	  context) op_context ;;
739	  -h|--help|help|"") sed -n '2,45p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; if [[ -z "$CMD" ]]; then exit 2; fi; exit 0 ;;
740	  *) usage "unknown command: $CMD (new|decide|confirm|reject|supersede|import|list|context)" ;;
741	esac
742
